summary: Full backend + frontend regression for Stream Anywhere. 23/23 pytest cases pass (auth, RBAC, streams CRUD+actions, sources, profiles/codecs, VOD/playlists, overview, analytics 1h/6h/24h, admin user mgmt). UI login as seeded admin, navigation to all 8 routes, stream create + start action, analytics range toggles, users page, logout all work end-to-end.

minor.issue: pydantic EmailStr rejects RFC-2606 reserved TLDs (.test) with 422. Not a bug per se, but tests must use real-looking domains. Consider documenting for QA.

issues: Recharts emits repeated 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings on first render of sparkline/chart containers. Cosmetic (charts do render correctly after resize), but should be fixed by giving ResponsiveContainer parents an explicit min-height or aspect ratio.

action_items: (Optional) Silence Recharts ResponsiveContainer width(-1) warnings by ensuring parent flex containers set min-height (Overview stat sparklines + Analytics charts).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/users list endpoint returns id as str(_id) (good) but other collections rely on {'_id':0} projection - consistent, acceptable.
server.py delete_user: uses raw ObjectId(user_id) without try/except; malformed id will raise 500 instead of 400/404. Low priority.
CORS_ORIGINS is explicit (not *) with allow_credentials=True - correct.
seed_admin + JWT via Bearer or cookie - verified working; login returns access_token in body.
No pagination on list endpoints (to_list(500) cap) - fine for MVP with simulated data.
test_credentials: admin@streamanywhere.io / Broadcast2026! (seeded); test users created dynamically with @example.com domain.
seed_data_creation: None persistent - test data uses TEST_ prefix and is cleaned up in fixtures where applicable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py, run with `pytest backend/tests/ -v`. All auth, RBAC and CRUD flows covered. UI data-testid coverage is comprehensive (nav-*, stat-*, stream-row-*, start/stop/failover/delete/preview-btn-{id}, new-*/save-*, range-*, logout-btn). Note: pydantic EmailStr rejects .test/.invalid TLDs; use @example.com for synthetic emails.
